svg.text: title_rect_cache_build measures overlay elements via getBoundingClientRect
Elements at horizon have scale(0) → getBoundingClientRect().width = 0
Centering: x = realCenter - overlayWidth/2 → x = realCenter - 0/2 → off-center!
Active deck unaffected: was at scale(1) → correct width measured live
Fix: cache natural widths at build time
title_rect_overlay_build: measure width/height before any transforms
title_state_list_get: use title_rect_natural for centering math (always correct)
Removed overlay measurement from title_rect_cache_build (no longer needed)
114: overlay at receded state → offsetWidth 0 (fixed with temp transform)
145: view_apply snap + overlay rebuild jump (fixed with skipTitleUpdate)
147: cache_build measured at scale(0) → width 0 (fixed with build-time cache)
Pattern: never measure scaled elements; cache natural dimensions at creation
